name: Open Facilitator Harness Adapter
description: Installs a harness worker (deterministic reference adapter) as a self-contained Node bundle plus a supervisor unit that attaches it to the team Gateway's child socket. Install order is irrelevant: units carry numeric prefixes and every Feature writes distinct files.

adapter.description: Adapter to install. Only 'deterministic' exists today; any other value fails the install.

configPath.description: Worker config the unit starts with; WORKER_CONFIG env overrides at runtime.
